sentences.en: Sudden decrease in appetite is sometimes a sign of illness.
sentences.zh: 突然食欲下降有时是生病的征兆。

sentences.en: The only thing that doesn't require skill is an appetite.
sentences.zh: 唯一不需要技巧的就是胃口。

sentences.en: He was weak as a rat, and had no appetite.
sentences.zh: 他瘦弱如鼠，完全没有食欲。

senses.zh: 欲望 - 胃口, 食欲 形容词: appetitive
